mapper.sql: id, user_id, code_pen_id, previous_review_id, source_hash, score, critical_finding_count, high_finding_count, medium_finding_count, summary, result_json, status, source_observed_at, reviewed_at, deleted, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO growth_code_review_record ( user_id, code_pen_id, previous_review_id, source_hash, score, critical_finding_count, high_finding_count, medium_finding_count, summary, result_json, status, source_observed_at, reviewed_at, deleted, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{codePenId}, #{previousReviewId}, #{sourceHash}, #{score}, #{criticalFindingCount}, #{highFindingCount}, #{mediumFindingCount}, #{summary}, #{resultJson}, #{status}, #{sourceObservedAt}, #{reviewedAt}, 0, NOW(), NOW() )
